intro.h2: Cabinets made for your room, not off a shelf
paragraphs: Arnold Custom Cabinets builds custom cabinets in Krum, Texas, for kitchens, bathrooms, offices and built-ins. Whether you are remodeling or have a new home under construction in North Texas, Jeremy will give you a free estimate.

Customers say he listens first. One homeowner had several bids, and Jeremy was the only one giving her what she wanted. He stood in the space, saw how it flowed and made suggestions she loved. When a larger company said it couldn't work with the glass she wanted in a couple of doors, Jeremy got excited about it. That glass is now part of her bar area.

items.name: Custom kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Kitchens are a big part of the work. The photos on Google show white painted cabinets with a butcher block island, a double wall oven tucked into tall cabinets and a stack of drawers below the cooktop. Each kitchen is built for the room it goes in.

image.alt: White kitchen cabinets with a butcher block island and a double wall oven

items.name: Bathroom vanities and linen cabinets
items.blurb: Need a vanity in a size you can't find in a store? Jeremy built one for a master bath that fit so well the trim didn't even have to be moved. Another customer also had a linen cabinet built for her bathroom, which she says she just loves.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a finished master bathroom in a North Texas home with a custom painted shaker-style vanity with soft-close drawers, a white quartz top and undermount sink, beside a matching tall linen cabinet. Warm white walls, charcoal hardware, light porcelain floor tile, sage green towel as a small accent, natural daylight from a side window. No people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names. Aspect ratio 4:3.
image.alt: Painted shaker-style bathroom vanity with drawers next to a tall linen cabinet

items.name: Built-ins for living rooms and offices
items.blurb: Built-ins turn a plain wall into storage and display space. One customer was thrilled with her custom built-ins, including a deep green office wall with open shelves above closed cabinets. Fireplace walls with floating shelves are another option shown on the Google profile.

image.alt: Deep green built-in cabinets with open shelves along a home office wall

items.name: Bar cabinets with glass doors
items.blurb: Want something a little different? One homeowner brought glass she hoped to use in a couple of doors, and Jeremy built it into a bar area with glass-front uppers, open wood shelves and a wine fridge. He says that bar was his favorite part.

image.alt: Bar area with glass-front upper cabinets, open wood shelves, granite top and wine fridge

about.text: Arnold Custom Cabinets is a cabinet maker at 1200 E McCart St in Krum, Texas, open weekdays from 7 AM to 3 PM. Jeremy is the person customers deal with, from standing in your space to plan the layout to installing the finished cabinets. He builds kitchens, bathroom vanities, linen cabinets, office walls, bars and built-ins, for remodels and for new homes under construction in North Texas. Reviewers call him professional, reliable, polite and truly talented, and say he has great communication. In his own words, he enjoys doing something a little different when he has the chance.

items.name: Shannon
items.text:
Working with Jeremy was such a pleasure.  We had several bids done and aside from the fact he was the lowest price, he was the ONLY one who was giving us what we wanted.  He stood in our space and saw how it flowed and made suggestions we just loved.  He also got excited when I showed him some glass I was hoping to use in a couple doors. service_area.h2: Custom cabinets in Krum and across North Texas
service_area.text: Arnold Custom Cabinets is based at 1200 E McCart St in Krum, Texas, and quotes on custom cabinets for homeowners who are remodeling or building a new home in North Texas. Towns are not listed one by one, so if you are unsure whether your project is in the area, call (214) 931-8647 on a weekday between 7 AM and 3 PM.

items.a: Yes. Arnold Custom Cabinets offers free estimates on custom cabinets. Call (214) 931-8647 or email arnoldcabinets@gmail.com with a few details about your room, and Jeremy can set up a time to look at the space and talk through what you would like built.

items.q: What rooms do you build cabinets for?
items.a: Kitchens, bathrooms and offices, plus built-ins for other rooms. Customers have had kitchens, a master bath vanity, a linen cabinet, a bar area with glass doors, a green office wall and a fireplace wall with shelves built. If you have a space in mind, ask about it.

items.q: Do you work on new homes?
items.a: Yes. If you are remodeling or have a new home under construction in North Texas, Arnold Custom Cabinets would like the chance to quote your cabinets. Reaching out while your plans are still being drawn gives the most room to get every size and detail right.

items.q: Can you use materials I already have?
items.a: Often, yes. One customer had glass she hoped to use in a couple of cabinet doors. A larger company said it couldn't work with it, but Jeremy said he enjoys doing something a little different, and built it into her bar cabinets. Bring your ideas to the estimate.

Arnold Custom Cabinets is open Monday to Friday from 7 AM to 3 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. The shop is at 1200 E McCart St #11 in Krum. Calling ahead at (214) 931-8647 is the best way to make sure Jeremy is there.
